name: groupagg_dyn
title: groupagg over dynamic (sparse Int64) keys: groups by first occurrence
expected_llvm_reason: the aggregate-only one pass (repro, or BLADE_GROUP_AGG=licensed) finds groups through the C core's key -> group map in both lanes, and the declined default build's LLVM CSR discovers them through the same map (round 3 W3-1, the separate LLVM dynamic-discovery change: the O(n * G) linear scan is retired)

hypothesis.natural: WIN (the natural tier discovers groups with ANY over the keys so far and folds with masked intrinsics: O(n * G) twice)
hypothesis.expert: repro: parity or a small loss (one hash probe per row in both); licensed: LOSS (Blade keeps the CSR's three hash operations per row, the gather and the K-lane peels: gap G71)

notes: Serial only, as groupagg. ngroups is the source range of the keys (7919 * floor(ngroups * u) + 13); the grouping itself is dynamic -- groups numbered by first occurrence, ~1009 of them. The default (licensed) Blade build declines the one pass (licensed float folds); BLADE_FP_REPRO=1 takes it. Named outputs: s, q, c in first-occurrence order (stored in every arm). Keys < 2^24 (the expert's multiplicative hash cannot overflow).
